caption: Katsushika Hokusai, South Wind, Clear Sky, from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji (c. 1830–32)
alt: A woodblock print of Mount Fuji turned deep red, its peak streaked with snow and its lower slopes darkened with forest, rising into a blue sky filled with rows of small white clouds.
bibliography: Katsushika Hokusai. South Wind, Clear Sky (Gaifū kaisei), also known as Red Fuji, from the series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei). c. 1830–32, woodblock print, ink and color on paper, Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (JP9).
title: South Wind, Clear Sky (Gaifū kaisei)
